section.name: The Dual-timer system
section.t: The publication pipeline validation enforces the following dual-timer constraints:

li.t: 30-day timer: A document MUST be finalized within 30 days from entering the AUTH48 or equivalent state.
10-day timer: This shorter window is automatically triggered once all authors have signaled all technical work is done.
The document is published at the end of timer one or two (whichever occurs first).

section.t: With explicit authorization of the IESG, the 30-day timer can be extended by maximum of ten days overall.
